bosses.name: Ephialtes
bosses.description: Tired of living as a "hero" in a repeating lie, he plunges into an abyss of no return and becomes "Ephialtes".

buffs.name: Corrosion
buffs.description: The internal structure has been corroded by excessively stored radiant energy. Dark DMG received is increased significantly.

skills.name: Eclipse Reaper
skills.description: Ephialtes drags his heavy scythe and leaps up to launch a violent strike.

skills.name: Shadow Bonecrusher
skills.description: Ephialtes swings the scythe to slash twice, then charges and unleashes a blade wave toward the target.

skills.name: Night Slash
skills.description: Ephialtes pulls the target in with his scythe, slashes multiple times, then fires a beam to damage the target.

skills.name: Shivering Edge
skills.description: Ephialtes dodges to hide his traces and dashes toward the target to launch an attack.

skills.name: Confinement Fissure
skills.description: Ephialtes raises his huge scythe and attacks the target.

bosses.name: Veronica
bosses.description: Born in the Church of Machina, she possesses overwhelming power that cannot be directly gazed upon. To her, hypocrisy is the red line that calls for punishment.

buffs.name: Plasmatic Corruption
buffs.description: Plasma Beam attacks can break through the defenses of Veronica's frame. Based on this, damage taken from Plasma Beam Effect will greatly increase. (Raydiance Effect DMG slightly increased)

skills.name: Rapid Thrust
skills.description: Veronica charges toward the enemy to deliver an upward thrust.

skills.name: Blazing Lance
skills.description: Veronica stabs the enemy three times with her lance.

skills.name: Shivering Assault
skills.description: Veronica spins and lashes the enemy multiple times with her tail.

skills.name: Judgement Spikes
skills.description: Veronica summons multiple spikes to attack the enemy.

skills.name: Touch of Condemnation
skills.description: Veronica leaps into the air, charges up, and hurls her lance. Upon returning, the lance creates a shockwave to strike the enemy.

skills.name: Decree Strike
skills.description: Veronica charges energy and throws her lance to knock the enemy away.

skills.name: Shadowbreaker
skills.description: Veronica strikes the enemy with her lance, then leaps above to strike the ground, creating many spikes that explode and deal AoE damage.

bosses.name: Trailblazer
bosses.description: "Chariot" of the Church of Machina. With an awe-inspiring and imposing lined design, he possesses unparalleled speed and raw power capable of shattering chaos. He always leads the charge at the forefront, poised to blaze a trail for his comrades.

buffs.name: Steel-willed
buffs.description: Fight with all your might and passion is the the greatest respect for your enemy.

skills.name: Barrage Slam
skills.description: Trailblazer unleashes a fan-shaped barrage in front of him before leaping into the air and slamming the ground with his right hand to deal AOE DMG.

skills.name: Rising Dragon
skills.description: Trailblazer charges toward his enemy and fires a close-range blast, using the recoil to leap high into the air before slamming his fist into the ground to deal AoE DMG.

skills.name: Blazing Shock
skills.description: Trailblazer leaps up with a blast, firing twice in mid-air before a powerful ground slam that creates a massive shockwave.

skills.name: Overlord Smash
skills.description: After a brief charge, Trailblazer leaps forward and smashes the ground with his right hand.

skills.name: Blitzstrike
skills.description: Trailblazer swiftly delivers a swift combination of elbow and uppercut strikes to the foe before him.

skills.name: Shelling March
skills.description: Trailblazer launches a barrage of shelling attacks to suppress his foe in the distance while closing in on them.
